TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will staff the Ministry’s 24x7 SOC and MDR service with a dedicated delivery organisation governed by our certified management systems and audited controls. We hold ISO 27001 for information security management (mandatory) and ISO 9001 for quality management, and maintain CMMI Level 3 process maturity, providing a disciplined foundation for repeatable SOC operations, change control, and service reporting across the three-year term [CO-PROFILE]. Our delivery is led by PMP-certified project managers (6 in-house) to ensure accountable governance, schedule control, and knowledge-transfer planning over the contract lifecycle [CO-PROFILE].

For quality assurance, we will run SOC design, onboarding, tuning, and steady-state operations through controlled artefacts (requirements traceability, configuration baselines, test/acceptance evidence, and service review minutes) aligned to ISO 9001/ISO 27001 controls and our CMMI L3 practices [CO-PROFILE]. We will apply documented incident-response runbooks and forensic-readiness procedures as controlled documents within the ISMS, with periodic review and continuous improvement [CO-PROFILE].

Relevant evidence of security delivery under ISO 27001 includes cybersecurity deployments [CAP-001] and [CAP-025], a provincial-government cybersecurity engagement [CAP-049], and a federal-government cloud infrastructure deployment under ISO 27001 governance [CAP-012].

Certification coverage gap: our library does not yet evidence named individual certifications such as CISSP/GIAC across all L1/L2/L3 tiers. We will address this through a named staffing plan at award, combining existing ISO 27001-governed security practitioners with targeted hiring/partnering of CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) resources for each tier, prior to SOC go-live.

Eligibility note: our average annual turnover evidenced is PKR 900M (3 audited years), which does not meet the RFP’s PKR 1,200M threshold [CO-PROFILE].
